responsibility: Resolves methods and associated value items during HIR type checking by exposing the lookup API and result/error types, probing receiver types for applicable inherent and trait candidates, confirming the selected candidate into a fully typed callee with receiver adjustments and obligations, diagnosing lookup failures and ambiguities with targeted suggestions, and emitting edition-compatibility lints and rewrites when prelude or `IntoIterator` changes would alter method-call resolution.
